description_en: Queries the information of upstream and downstream nodes. Only one level can be queried
description_zh: 查询上下游节点的信息，只能查询一层
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-node-io --node-id 1234 --project-env PROD --io-type output --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNodeIO

parameters.help_en: The ID of the node. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173979.html to query the NodeId
parameters.help_zh: 节点的ID。您可参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173979.html查看NodeId相关信息
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The environment in which the node runs. Valid values: DEV (development environment) and PROD (production environment)
parameters.help_zh: 运行的环境，包括DEV（开发环境）和PROD（生产环境）
parameters.name: project_env

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query upstream or downstream nodes. Valid values: input and output
parameters.help_zh: 指定查询节点为上游节点还是下游节点。包括input和output
parameters.name: io_type
